beats.text: From a palace terrace, a hunchbacked maid named Manthara watched the flags and flowers with a sour face.
'Why is the city rejoicing?' she asked. When she heard Rama would be crowned, she burned with anger and ran to her queen.
'Wake up, my queen! Rama becomes king tomorrow, and your son Bharata will have nothing.'
But Kaikeyi was delighted. She gave Manthara a jewel. 'Rama is like my own son,' she said.
Manthara threw it away. 'Remember the two boons the king once gave you, when you saved his life in the war against the demons?'
At first Kaikeyi loved Rama as her own son. But slowly, the poison of doubt took hold.
She tore off her jewels, put on soiled clothes, and lay on the bare floor of the anger chamber.
